card.architecture: MiniMax-H3 fl2va (Qwen3-VL 32B, int8 ConvRot) — IMAGE-TO-VIDEO with native audio
card.summary: Animate a still into a clip with NATIVE stereo audio — voice, sound effects and music generated together with the motion. The uploaded image is the first frame; an optional last frame pins the ending. Output is an mp4 with a baked-in audio track.
use_cases: camera moves / subject motion on a still
card.pick_when: You want to animate the current picture into a short clip whose audio is generated along with the motion.

prompt.guidance: Describe the motion AND the audio; the image defines appearance, the prompt directs motion and sound.
prompt.example: the camera slowly pushes in as her hair drifts in the wind. Audio: a soft breeze, a low ambient hum, a gentle piano motif.
prompt.overview: The uploaded image is the first frame, so describe only how the visible subject and camera MOVE, then add an 'Audio:' line — H3 generates the soundtrack (ambience, effects, dialogue, score) jointly with the motion.
prompt.instructions: Lead with the primary motion using concrete verbs with explicit speed and direction, specify a distinct camera move, and add atmosphere. Then add an 'Audio:' section describing ambience, timed sound effects, any dialogue, and score. Animate only elements visible in the source frame; skip static appearance (the image defines it). Quote spoken lines. Timeline cues like [0s-2s] help place motion and audio beats.
do: Lead with the primary motion (concrete verb + speed + direction)
Specify a camera move (slow push-in, dolly out, pan, orbit, static)
Add an explicit 'Audio:' line: ambience, timed effects, dialogue, score
Describe only motion of elements visible in the source image
Quote spoken lines; use [0s-2s] cues to time beats
dont: Don't re-describe the subject's static appearance (the image defines it)
Don't introduce objects or scenery not present in the source frame
Don't rely on negative prompts — this is a distilled model
Don't forget the audio: leaving it out wastes H3's main capability
examples: The woman slowly turns her head to the left, her hair drifting in a light breeze. Slow push-in, shallow depth of field, warm color grade, calm mood. Audio: a soft breeze, faint room tone, a gentle piano motif entering halfway.

speed.measured_note: large video model with a 32B text encoder; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Animate the current picture into a clip WITH sound. Describe the motion and the audio.

edit_use_cases: image-to-video: animate the current picture into a clip with native audio (optional last frame)

reference.hint: Animate the current picture: describe the motion and the audio you want.
